# The 72-Hour Kit Customizer: Scenario-Specific Build Plans for Your Family, Climate, and Needs

### A Modular Template Pack for Real Families in Real Places Facing Real Risks

---

## PART ONE: FULL TABLE OF CONTENTS

---

### FRONT MATTER
- Welcome Letter: Why Generic Kits Fail Real Families
- How to Use This Template Pack (The Branching System Explained)
- The 5-Minute Household Intake Questionnaire *(your entry point to the entire system)*

---

### MODULE 1: THE INTAKE QUESTIONNAIRE & YOUR CUSTOM BUILD PATH
**Section 1.1** — The Household Profile Form
- Household size (individuals 1–2 / family 3–4 / large household 5+)
- Ages and life stages present (infant, toddler, school-age, teen, adult, senior 65+)
- Geographic region (coastal, inland, mountain, desert, urban core, rural)
- Climate zone (tropical, subtropical, temperate, arid, semi-arid, continental, subarctic)
- Primary disaster risk (select up to 3): hurricane, wildfire, earthquake, tornado, winter storm, flooding, urban grid failure, civil unrest, industrial accident
- Medical, mobility, or dietary flags (yes/no branching)
- Pet presence (yes/no branching)
- Vehicle access and mobility (own vehicle / public transit dependent / mobility device user)
- Storage space available (apartment closet / garage / basement / vehicle only)
- Budget tier (essential $75–150 / recommended $150–300 / comprehensive $300–500+)

**Section 1.2** — How to Read Your Build Path Results
- Understanding your Primary Scenario Code (PSC)
- Understanding your Household Modifier Codes (HMC)
- How to stack modules: which sections apply to you and in what order
- The "Baseline First, Customize Second" rule explained

**Section 1.3** — Your Personalized Build Summary Sheet *(fill-in template)*
- Pre-labeled fields for your PSC, HMC flags, budget tier, and storage footprint
- Space to record your target completion date and budget allocation per category

---

### MODULE 2: THE UNIVERSAL BASELINE KIT (Everyone Starts Here)
**Section 2.1** — The Non-Negotiable Core: What Every Kit Must Contain Regardless of Scenario
- Water: the baseline calculation explained
- Food: calorie minimums by life stage
- First aid: the true minimum vs. the "nice to have" bloat
- Communication and navigation tools
- Light and power
- Sanitation and hygiene
- Documents and cash

**Section 2.2** — The Calorie & Water Calculator Template *(pre-filled by household size)*
- 1-person / 2-person / 3-4 person / 5-6 person / 7+ person calculation tables
- Age and activity-level adjustment rows
- Pregnancy and breastfeeding modifier
- Heat climate water multiplier (+50% rule explained)
- 72-hour totals with a 20% buffer baked in

**Section 2.3** — The Baseline Shopping List Template *(fill-in with checkbox system)*
- Organized by category with suggested quantity ranges per household size
- "Buy now" tier vs. "add within 30 days" tier
- Estimated cost range per line item
- Rotation and expiration tracking column

**Section 2.4** — The Baseline Storage & Packing Guide
- Bag vs. bin vs. distributed cache: which is right for your living situation
- Weight limits and ergonomic packing rules (who carries what)
- Waterproofing your kit on a budget
- The "grab order" system: what leaves the house in the first 90 seconds

---

### MODULE 3: SCENARIO-SPECIFIC BUILD OVERLAYS
*(Apply the overlay that matches your Primary Scenario Code after completing the baseline)*

**Section 3.1** — Hurricane & Tropical Storm Overlay (PSC: HUR)
- Pre-landfall vs. shelter-in-place vs. evacuation sub-scenarios
- Storm-specific water storage strategies (bathtub bladders, WaterBOB)
- Wind and water damage documentation prep
- Fuel strategy

listing.description: Every emergency preparedness checklist you've ever downloaded assumed you live alone, eat anything, have no mobility issues, and face some mythical average disaster. You don't. You have a family with real dietary restrictions, a child or parent with a medication dependency, and you live somewhere with a specific threat profile — hurricanes, wildfires, winter blackouts, or urban grid failures. Generic advice forces you to reverse-engineer everything yourself, which is exactly why most families never actually finish building their kit. This product was built to eliminate that friction entirely. The 72-Hour Kit Customizer is a modular template pack that starts with a short intake questionnaire and then routes you down a branching build path matched to your household size, climate zone, geographic region, likely disaster scenarios, and any medical or mobility needs in your family. You're not editing someone else's list. You're building from a system that treats your situation as the starting point. Inside the pack you'll find scenario-specific gear and food sourcing recommendations with current retailer links, a calorie and water calculator pre-filled by family size, a climate-adjusted supply swap guide that tells you what to add or remove based on whether you're in a humid Gulf Coast summer or a high-altitude freeze zone, and a dedicated medical needs supplement sheet covering medications, mobility aids, dietary formulas, and chronic condition supplies. Whether you're preparing for a Category 4 landfall, a week-long power outage, or a wildfire evacuation with fifteen minutes notice, this system gives you a completed, actionable, personalized build plan — not homework. This is the only emergency preparedness product on the market that builds the customization logic directly into the template structure itself, so you stop staring at a checklist wondering if it applies to you and start actually getting your family protected.

Built-in calorie and water calculator pre-filled by family size so you know exactly how much food and water to stockpile without doing math from scratch
Climate-adjusted supply swap guide tells you precisely what to add, remove, or substitute based on your geographic region and seasonal conditions
